records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended April 2, 2022, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The change in twelve-month backlog at April 2, 2022 as compared with the twelve-month backlog at April 3, 2021 was driven by increases in all segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: However, the impacts of the pandemic have placed labor and supply chain pressures on our business and we have been impacted by customer demand variability.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin in the second quarter of 2022 increased compared to the second quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our available borrowing capacity and our cash flow from operations have provided us with the financial resources needed to make organic investments, fund acquisitive growth and return capital to shareholders.
